label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee/tribute gathering for the mayor at the great hall: eight lanterns, 200 fresh loaves, and a discreet escort bringing the mayor at 18:00. The mayor was intentionally kept unaware of the occasion until the gathering; he learned the invitation and attendance time before then, but not its purpose. The neighbour helped publicize the gathering to residents, but the record does not establish that the neighbour knowingly helped prepare the secret event.
